news.title: OpenAI hires former U.S. Army Secretary Dan Driscoll for national security role
news.summary: OpenAI has hired former U.S. Army Secretary Dan Driscoll for a newly created national security role for national security modernization.

news.title: Apple's quarter is not perfect. But with enough to like, we raised our price target
news.summary: We remain "own it, don't trade it" on Apple stock.

news.title: Jim Cramer says lower oil prices are giving stocks a boost. Can it last?
news.summary: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said falling oil prices and interest rates are fueling a rally.

news.title: Palantir reports booming U.S. commercial revenue growth, topping government for first time
news.summary: Palantir's commercial revenue jumped 148% to $984 million, surpassing government revenue of $953 million.

news.title: Feeling isolated? Half of in-office workers describe their desk jobs as 'remote,' NY Fed survey finds
news.summary: Employees describing jobs as 'remote' are now often in-office, as companies fail to create the collaboration they claim is critical, NY Fed research shows.

news.title: Intel foundry push faces critical test after stock's 45% plunge in October
news.summary: Intel’s turnaround now hinges on proving its foundry strategy can deliver, as customers look for signs the company will add fab capacity and catch TSMC

news.title: Fanatics takes bigger NHL design role with all-32 team Hometown Remix jerseys
news.summary: Fanatics and the NHL debuted Hometown Remix, a special-edition uniform and apparel program covering all 32 teams.

news.title: Anthropic reports $17 billion in Q3 revenue, purchase commitments of $895.4 billion in revised S-1
news.summary: Anthropic unveiled its S-1 prospectus last week, but the initial filing only included the company's financials through the first half of the year.

news.title: Lumentum CEO touts 'enormous' opportunity in massive AI connectivity deal with Marvell
news.summary: The AI infrastructure deal is expected to close during the first half of 2028.

news.title: Crude prices slide as investors brace for a big week
news.summary: Futures push higher ahead of Apple, the midterms and jobs data due Friday

news.title: OpenAI deepens Abu Dhabi foothold as Sam Altman inks deals spanning energy, government and investment
news.summary: OpenAI signed four Abu Dhabi agreements spanning energy, government and investment as Sam Altman met the emirate’s crown prince.

news.title: South Korea targets 'world's highest performance' sovereign AI model in record new budget
news.summary: The 2027 budget will rise 12.8% to 820.9 trillion won, and will include a 21.3 trillion won investment into semiconductors, physical AI and AI data centers.

news.title: Automakers like Rivian and Ford are ‘democratizing 3D printing’ to reduce costs and increase speed
news.summary: Automakers including Ford, Rivian and GM are expanding 3D printing to make prototypes, factory tools and low-volume parts faster and at lower cost.

news.title: State Street CEO Says It’s ‘Hard to See’ AI as a Bubble Yet
news.summary: State Street Corp. Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Ron O’Hanley said it’s “hard to see” AI as being a bubble yet, with demand supporting the massive investments being poured into the technology.

news.title: DBS CEO on How Southeast Asia's Biggest Bank Deploys AI
news.summary: DBS Group CEO Tan Su Shan talks about the bank’s aggressive adoption of AI, how the Binance hack shows the need for tightening cyber hygiene, as well as the growth in wealth flows in both Singapore and Hong Kong. She speaks exclusively to Bloomberg's The China Show on the sidelines of an HKMA investment summit. (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Apple Forecast Tops Estimates, Disappoints Investors
news.summary: Apple has delivered a forecast for the holiday period that topped Wall Street estimates, even as it failed to impress investors who have bid up the shares in recent months. For more on a mixed first report card under new CEO John Ternus, Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow dissects the numbers. (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Grab Raises Sales, Earnings Forecasts on Rising Ride Demand
news.summary: Grab Holdings Ltd. raised its full-year revenue and profit forecasts after quarterly earnings beat estimates, signaling confidence that rising ride-hailing and food-delivery demand across Southeast Asia will offset regulatory hurdles.

news.title: L&G AM CEO on APAC, Growth Outlook
news.summary: Eric Adler, CEO of L&G Asset Management, discusses his outlook and strategy for business growth in APAC. He speaks exclusively with David Ingles and Yvonne Man on the sidelines of the Hong Kong Monetary Authority Global Financial Leaders' Investment Summit. (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Franklin Templeton CEO on Investment, Growth Outlook
news.summary: Jenny Johnson, CEO of Franklin Templeton, discusses her outlook for APAC and global markets, investment strategies, and the strategies for business growth. She speaks exclusively with David Ingles and Yvonne Man on the sidelines of the Hong Kong Monetary Authority Global Financial Leaders' Investment Summit. (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Apple Sets New Sales Highs in China Even as Increased Costs Bite
news.summary: Apple Inc. reached new sales records in China in the September quarter, softening the blow of rising costs for components like memory and navigating soft consumer demand better than rivals.

news.title: HKMA Chief Yue on HK Growth
news.summary: Eddie Yue, Chief Executive of the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, discusses his outlook for Hong Kong's 3Q growth, and his expectation on the city's exchange fund performance. He speaks with David Ingles and Yvonne Man on the sidelines of the Hong Kong Monetary Authority Global Financial Leaders' Investment Summit. (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Palantir’s Outlook Signals a Slowdown in AI-Fueled Sales Growth
news.summary: Palantir Technologies Inc., the AI-powered data and analytics platform that counts the US military among its chief customers, issued a quarterly outlook that pointed to a potential slowdown in sales growth.

news.title: Disney Plans Thousands of Layoffs, Targeting 20% Cost Savings
news.summary: Walt Disney Co. is moving toward thousands of job cuts with the entertainment giant asking some managers to target 20% in annual cost savings, according to people familiar with the matter.

news.title: OpenAI Says Former Army Secretary Dan Driscoll to Join Company
news.summary: OpenAI is hiring former US Army Secretary Dan Driscoll to help expand the use of artificial intelligence for national and cyber security.

news.title: North Korea Denies Role in $6.3 Billion Binance Crypto Heist
news.summary: North Korea rejected US claims that it was behind the theft of more than $6 billion in cryptocurrency from Binance, after the FBI blamed an elite team of Pyongyang’s hackers for the biggest crypto heist on record.

news.title: Oracle Is Near $10 Billion Share Sale at 11% Discount
news.summary: Oracle Corp. is poised to price the sale of $10 billion in shares at an 11% discount, according to people familiar with the matter, after the company’s stock price was dinged in a choppy session to start the week.

news.title: Apple’s Tightening Margins Overshadow Upbeat Holiday Forecast
news.summary: Apple Inc. delivered a mixed outlook to investors in its first quarterly report under Chief Executive Officer John Ternus, with narrower profit margins overshadowing an upbeat sales forecast.

news.title: Apple Sales Meet Estimates, China Is a Weak Spot
news.summary: Apple posted September quarter revenue that narrowly topped analysts’ estimates, even as sales in the key Chinese market fell short of projections. Revenue rose 12% to $114.5 billion during the fiscal fourth quarter, which ended Sept. 26, the company said in a statement. news.title: Apple Looks Very Smart in Modest AI Spend: Tom Forte
news.summary: Tom Forte of Maxim Group says he is especially interested in commentary on the December quarter, when the latest iPhone models will have had more time to affect sales. He said initial demand for the new iPhone duo appears strong and pointed to pent-up interest in a foldable iPhone after a long wait. He speaks with Kailey Leinz & Ed Ludlow on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: iPhone Duo Sales To Hit 7M in 2026, Predicts IDC Sr. Director
news.summary: IDC Senior Director of Data & Analytics Nabila Popal says Apple’s iPhone results beating analyst expectations were not surprising. IDC’s preliminary shipment data showed iPhones outperforming a smartphone market that had suffered a historic 21% decline in calendar Q3, while Apple’s shipments fell only 4%. She speaks with Kailey Leinz & Ed Ludlow on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Anthropic Taps Macquarie, CommSec for Australia IPO Retail Offer
news.summary: Anthropic PBC has tapped eight firms including Macquarie Group Ltd. and Commonwealth Bank of Australia’s CommSec unit for its Australian retail offer ahead of its highly anticipated Nasdaq debut that’s set to be among the largest ever initial public offerings.

news.title: Detroit Future City CEO: Unemployment Is Down in Detroit
news.summary: Anika Goss, CEO of Detroit Future City, says the city has seen a recent population increase, driven largely by new immigrants, but is not growing as quickly or broadly as desired. Downtown investment and visible revitalization have emerged mainly over the past five to ten years, after decades of decline, and have not yet spread to communities at the pace residents would like. She speaks with Romai...

news.title: Apple Sales Slow Down, China Revenue Misses Estimates
news.summary: Apple says sales slowed down in the fiscal fourth quarter, but still beat estimates. Revenue out of China missed estimates. This is the first earnings report posted under CEO John Ternus. Bloomberg's Ed Ludlow and Mark Gurman report. (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Apple may try to increase revenue by doing…something with third-party AI apps
news.summary: Apple hinted at ways that it could spur revenue through third-party "opportunities" during its Monday night earnings call.

news.title: Ukraine’s new pocket-sized gadget turns Russian drones’ cameras against them
news.summary: A Kyiv startup’s pocket-sized, 10-ounce receiver lets Ukrainian troops watch the video feeds of Russian drones, though Russian moves toward digital video and AI-guided drones that emit no signals could make the victory short-lived.

news.summary: Y Combinator Garry Tan has jokingly admitted that he's suffered from "cyber psychosis” and barely sleeps sometimes because he’s so excited to be working with his AI agents. On a new episode of Walter Isaacson’s podcast, The Builders, Tan put a price tag on his passion.

news.title: Hinge tests a cheaper plan as users become more fed up paying for dating apps
news.summary: At a time when people are increasingly tired of dating apps, Hinge is testing a cheaper subscription plan.

news.title: Apple says it’s ‘hard to predict’ when iPhone Duo constraints will improve
news.summary: Apple says iPhone Duo production is ramping up, but it still can't say when supply will catch up with demand as shipping delays stretch into next year.

news.summary: RSI is the point at which AI grows so good at training itself that it spawns a dramatic acceleration of AI capabilities. To the AI doomers, RSI represents the cataclysm from which there is no return.

news.title: Germany says lawmakers’ iPhones may have been hacked with spyware

news.summary: The New York Times is suing privacy-focused web browser company Brave for allegedly scraping the outlet’s copyrighted content and unlawfully distributing it to its own customers, like Anthropic and Perplexity.

news.summary: The plaintiffs said they started using YouTube as young as age 3 and other social media platforms at around age 9 and developed compulsive usage habits that they attributed to features such as autoplay and infinite scrolling.

news.summary: Marvell's planned purchase of Lumentum is one of the biggest acquisitions in tech history. And they both have the same strategic investor: Nvidia.

news.summary: SpaceX has been looking for new ways to use its Starlink network, and a tie-up with cellular operator Boost Mobile could give it the terrestrial access it needs.

news.title: Elon Musk throttles Grok Bot limits due to ‘unsustainably high’ costs
news.summary: Musk recently referred to Grok Bot as having "the fastest growth of a product that I've ever seen in my life."

news.title: Omen AI adds liquid know-how in $16 million Aquatic Labs acquisition
news.summary: Two startups tackling the data center water problem are joining forces in a $16 million deal.

news.title: Ninja’s first-ever microwave just replaced two of my kitchen appliances at once
news.summary: The Ninja Crispi Microwave stands out for its FusionCrisp technology, which combines the speed of a microwave with the crispy results you'd expect from an air fryer.

news.title: Northwood Space raises $375M Series C at a $2B valuation from a16z and DFJ Growth
news.summary: Space infrastructure company Northwood Space on Monday said it had raised $375 million in a Series C round co-led by Andreessen Horowitz and DFJ Growth, valuing the company at $2 billion.
